bio: Jeck Da General is the producer Black co-produced That Boy Hi Hat's Idol or Icon (2021) with; Black owns the rights to every That Boy Hi Hat track connected to Jeck Da General. He produced Flamerz (conflict resolved by Black on 2026-09-15 — the earlier Kokurcho Medium credit was the error). Qobuz metadata lists Jeck Da General in production/composer roles on some That Boy Hi Hat tracks; per-track verification is still pending.
